pool.b.staff_cotrainer_aufstellung_gruss: Boss, got a minute? It's about the line-up.
Coach, come to the office for a moment, I have to get something off my chest.
pool.b.staff_cotrainer_aufstellung_lage: I think the eleven from the last game was a mistake, we lack balance in midfield.
I see the starting eleven differently from you, especially in the centre and the back line.
The way you line us up, we walk straight into the knife, and I'm telling you that now!
I can't keep quiet about this any longer, this line-up is a recipe for the next defeat!
You know I stand behind you, but I disagree on the line-up, and I owe it to you to say so openly.
I back every decision, just not this eleven, not without telling you my doubts first.
If we want to compete at the top we need a different eleven, and I have a concrete plan.
With this line-up we stay below our potential, I would rebuild the centre and the wings.
I would rotate far more and pick fresher legs, this unchanging eleven paralyses us.
We line up too rigidly, more movement in the starting eleven would do us good.
It isn't easy for me to contradict you, but I don't feel right about this line-up.
I hesitate to bring it up because I don't want to hurt you, but the eleven doesn't convince me.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_gruss: Boss, got a moment? The load figures worry me.
Coach, I need to write you something about the squad's data.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage: With this density of fixtures the players barely recover, and the training figures have been falling for weeks.
There's too little time between games to regenerate, the muscles are shutting down, and the measurements show it.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage.hitz: If this goes on the players will break down one after another, and don't come to me afterwards!
This is exploitation of the players, and I won't take the blame afterwards!
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage.loya: I always pull my weight, you know me, but here I have to hit the brakes before something happens.
I've never dug in when you asked for more, but now I'm warning you seriously.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage.ehrg: Whoever wants to compete at the top must be fresh in the last third of the season too, and for that I need rest days.
You don't win titles on tired legs, so let's manage the load cleverly.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage.wech: We've been in the same rhythm for weeks, a bit more variety in training and playing time would do everyone good.
The same faces for the full length every time, no body can take that.
pool.b.staff_fitness_belastung_lage.sens: I can see how tired the lads are, and it honestly gets to me.
It wears me down to watch them struggle without anyone saying a word.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_gruss: Boss, got a minute? It's about my goalkeepers.
Coach, I need to talk to you about the situation in goal.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage: In goal nobody knows where he stands, and without clear roles the whole team's security suffers.
My keepers train at a high level, but nobody knows his role, and it wears them down.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage.hitzi: You can't treat goalkeepers like this, I demand a clear statement at last!
This back and forth in goal drives everyone mad, and I won't let it go on!
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage.loyal: I've never interfered with your line-up, but now I ask for a clear word for my people.
You know I back your line, but in goal we need a line one can actually see.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage.ehrge: If you want to compete at the top you need a keeper who knows he plays and a second who knows why not.
With clear roles we get more out of both keepers, and for that I want your decision.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage.wechs: I would have the two keepers alternate regularly, that keeps both hungry.
A fixed rotation in goal would take pressure off and keep both alert.
pool.b.staff_torwart_rotation_lage.sensi: A keeper who doesn't know whether he plays loses confidence, and that hits me hard.
I can see my keepers doubting themselves, and I don't know how to help them.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_gruss: Boss, got a minute? We in the staff need to talk to you.
Coach, I'm speaking for the whole staff here, we have a request.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage: We're working at the limit, and with the personnel and equipment we have we can't get any more out of it.
We lack people in analysis and care, and the technology is long outdated.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage.hi: You can't do a proper job like this, and we won't be fobbed off with scraps any longer!
It's a joke, the resources we have here, and I'll tell the chairman myself!
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage.lo: We've never complained and always worked with what was there, but now it simply isn't enough.
I stand by this club and by you, but I have to be honest: this won't take us further.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage.eh: If we want to compete at the top the staff needs the resources of the competition, or we'll always be a step behind.
With better equipment and a couple of additional people we get the points we're missing now.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage.we: Other clubs invest in their staff, and good people go where they can work.
If nothing moves here, we're replaceable or gone too, one has to be honest.
pool.b.staff_mittel_verstaerkung_lage.se: We don't feel seen, and it hurts that our work receives so little recognition.
We give everything, and it's hard to see that hardly anyone at the club notices how much is missing.
